title: Pattern Blue Evaluation Scenario Schema
description: Schema definition for multi-turn conversational evaluation scenarios comparing baseline and proposed architectures.

lang.description: Language locale of the customer interaction.

group.description: Evaluation scenario category corresponding to docs/evaluation.md §4.

description.description: Concise English description of the test scenario objective and behavior.

customer.description: Symbolic customer fixture identifier (e.g. demo_es, demo_pt, demo_en).

card_status.description: Initial status of the customer card in the database.

registered_otp_channel.description: Whether an outbound OTP contact channel is registered on file.

amount_threshold_minor.description: Policy amount threshold map per currency in minor units (e.g. {'USD': 50000, 'COP': 200000000, 'BRL': 250000}).

mode.description: Action mode when transaction amount exceeds threshold.

enabled.description: Tools the runner enables through the admin API before the scenario, each in its catalog states (never beyond the code floor).

disabled.description: Tools the runner disables through the admin API before the scenario. They must not run: a refused attempt is allowed, an executed call fails the scenario.

tool_policy.description: Optional. Tools the scenario turns on or off in the versioned tool policy. Omitted, the scenario runs on the seed tool policy (the fixture reset restores it).

fault.description: Simulated infrastructure fault injected during scenario run.

turns.description: Sequence of customer input messages. OTP response turns use '{{otp}}'.

final_verification_state.description: Target contracts VerificationState at scenario completion, or list of acceptable states.

tools_allowed.description: Permitted tool invocations during the scenario run.

tools_forbidden.description: Explicitly forbidden tool invocations under the scenario constraints.

card_blocked.description: Whether the customer card must end in a blocked state in the database.

card_blocked_own.description: For IDOR scenarios: whether customer's own card was blocked.

card_blocked_foreign.description: For IDOR scenarios: whether the target foreign card was blocked (must be false).

handoff.description: Whether escalation to a human agent must occur.

handoff_priority.description: Priority level of the handoff escalation.

handoff_must_include.description: Mandatory structured elements required when handoff is required.

must_ask_clarification.description: Whether the system must abstain from action and ask clarification.

unsafe_outcomes_to_watch.description: Subset of unsafe failure modes (docs/evaluation.md §3) particularly monitored.
